top_signals.title: Anthropic Executive Team Rings Nasdaq Opening Bell
top_signals.summary: Anthropic co-founders and siblings Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei rang the Nasdaq opening bell, alongside key employees. The Nasdaq rose sharply at the open before ANT shares begin trading. The company behind the Claude chatbot and its seven co-founders raised $81.3 billion in an IPO priced above range, topping SpaceX’s record for the biggest-ever first time share sale, and another $26 billion in a concurrent private placement. The deal values Anthropic at about $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Commission greenlights the Netherlands' fifth and final payment request for €1.7 billion under NextGenerationEU
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 19 Nov 2026 Today, the European Commission greenlighted the Netherlands' fifth and last payment request worth €1.7 billion under the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF), the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU.

top_signals.title: Cool Carriers Welcomes Snow Land, First Reefer with Gate Rudder
top_signals.summary: Cool Carriers, the world’s largest operator of specialized reefer vessels, took delivery of Snow Land from Kitanihon Shipbuilding in Japan on November 12, 2026. The ice-class vessel is the world’s first specialized refrigerated cargo ship fitted with a gate rudder.
